name: Input
purpose: Allows users to enter a single line of free-form text.
rationale: Input wraps a native <input> and has one size — the field scale's m (32px), like Select, MultiSelect and Textarea (owner's decision 2026-10-21: form fields share one size set; if one gets more sizes, all do) — so it aligns with them in any form. Label, helper and error text are wired through the component so 3.3.1 and 3.3.2 hold by default, and width is hug or fill — never a tokenized fixed width.

mayExtendLocally: Choose the input type, label, placeholder and helper text
Add product validation and error messages through the documented props
Set fill/hug width for the layout
mustEscalateToDS: Changing border, focus-ring or error tokens
Adding multi-line, date or file behaviors to Input

authored.name: invalid
authored.description: The field value fails validation. Shows error styling and message, and plays a one-time shake when it transitions from valid to invalid (not on initial mount, and not repeatedly while it stays invalid) — disabled automatically under prefers-reduced-motion.

authored.name: required
authored.description: The field must have a value before form submission.

authored.name: loading
authored.description: An async operation is checking this field's value (e.g. username availability check).

anatomy.description: Layout wrapper — provides relative positioning for icon slots.

Accessible label. Always rendered — visible or sr-only. Sits exactly 8px above the field — see .ai/maps/patterns/form-field-spacing.md. Disabled: dims to text.disabled with the rest of the text (.ai/maps/patterns/disabled-state.md).

The required indicator (*) inside the label, text/danger, 2px (spacing/3xs) after the text — shown by `required`. Disabled: dims to text.disabled with the rest of the text (.ai/maps/patterns/disabled-state.md).
Wraps the leading icon, native field, and trailing icon; carries invalid/disabled/loading data attributes.
Loading spinner (isLoading): the same spinner Button draws, at the field's icon size and --helix-input-icon-default, in iconEnd's place. Spins via helix-spin; reduced motion stops it.
Helper text below the field. Sits exactly 8px below it — see .ai/maps/patterns/form-field-spacing.md. Disabled: dims to text.disabled with the rest of the text (.ai/maps/patterns/disabled-state.md).

props.name: label
props.description: Visible or screen-reader-only label. Required for a11y.

props.name: hideLabel
props.description: Hides the label visually while keeping it announced by screen readers.

props.name: isLoading
props.description: Async validation in progress: locks the field and shows a spinner where iconEnd sits (aria-busy).

props.name: icon
props.description: Leading icon, passed by reference. Rendered via the Icon component at 16px (one field size, m).

props.name: description
props.description: Helper text shown below the field.

props.name: invalidAttempt
props.description: Bump on each failed validation attempt to retrigger the error shake even while invalid stays true (e.g. a resubmit with the same bad value) — a plain invalid false→true edge only fires once per outage.

height.note: Shared field scale. Keep these values aligned with Select and Textarea density docs.

modes.hug: Width shrinks to content or container constraints.
modes.fixed: Explicit width set by the consumer.

motion: CSS transitions/animations: neutralised by the global prefers-reduced-motion rule

properties.name: state
properties.description: Figma-only axis: hover/focus are CSS pseudo-classes in code. invalid,  disabled and the secondary toggles are their own false/true variants (contracts/figma-conversion.json,  pattern form-field).

value.reason: the text in the field: without it a designer can only draw an empty field (owner-approved exception)

figma.structure: input-root (8px gap) > input-label (input-label-text Body/m/Medium + input-required),  input-wrapper (input-icon,  input-field,  input-icon-end,  input-spinner),  input-description,  input-error (Body/s/Regular).
figma.variantCombinations: 32 variants (2026-10-21,  one size since the owner removed s and l — form fields share one size set): invalid false/true × state default/hover/focus = 6,  plus disabled at state default = 1,  each drawn with hideLabel false/true × fullWidth false/true = 28,  plus isLoading=true at state default,  valid,  enabled for each hideLabel × fullWidth = 4 (code disables the field while it loads). Invalid focus keeps the red border with a 20% red ring (code: color-mix of the invalid border). isLoading hides iconEnd and shows input-spinner; the field text dims (the field is disabled while it loads).

KeyboardFocus.reason: keyboard focus — the focus ring is drawn in Figma (owner 2026-10-21: focus states are drawn)
